raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 2
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly deduced that the father-in-law of Maria Luisa Gabriella of Savoy was Louis XIV of France. The available text from the WebSurfer's first search (step 2) explicitly states that Maria Luisa Gabriella was the wife of King Philip V and the daughter of Victor Amadeus II and Anne Marie of Orléans. It also notes that her mother, Anne Marie, was the daughter of Philippe I, Duke of Orléans. The father-in-law is the father of her husband (Philip V). While Philip V was indeed the son of Louis, Grand Dauphin (the son of Louis XIV), the father-in-law is Louis, Grand Dauphin, not Louis XIV. Louis XIV was the grandfather-in-law. The Planner failed to distinguish between the grandfather and the father, leading to the wrong answer.
